document: R5-C — the quality-cost frontier as a CURVE (理 11395/11397)
why_excluded: a budget with fewer than 300 finished problems is NOT plotted and NOT quoted. A partial arm on a curve is invisible -- it looks like every other point.
SCOPE_SENTENCE_that_every_conclusion_mus: This curve covers base budgets [8, 12, 14, 16, 18, 24] and head budgets [6, 8, 10, 12], on v3 seed 21's 300 problems, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.  No conclusion drawn from it may be stated more broadly than that -- 理's rule (nirai 11399): a stated exclusion in a measurement becomes a silent omission in the conclusion built on it, so the exclusion is restated INSIDE the conclusion or the conclusion is scoped to the measurement.

readings_written_before_the_runs.above across the range: the frontier is moved over THE RANGE MEASURED (named in SCOPE_SENTENCE), not a point and not 'in general'
readings_written_before_the_runs.cross at low budget: the head helps only where it has room to act (§7.5's bound in cost terms)
readings_written_before_the_runs.merge at high budget: compute substitutes for experience there; print the range

bounds: Each budget is a DIFFERENT AGENT (the budget is in the prompt); no point is a truncation of another.
Head tokens are ALL-IN (model + R2b's measured controller). Model-tokens-only would flatter the head by ~2.5k/episode.
One seed (v3 seed 21), one model, 300 problems per point, paired per problem.
A paired CI is computed only where the two arms cover the same 300 problems; None means they did not and no interval is quoted.

THE_RESULT.equal quality, 2.3x the compute: base@24 reaches 24.0% at 13858.2 tokens/episode. head@6 reaches the SAME 24.0% at 5979.3. Paired on the same 300 the difference is +0.0 points, CI [-5.3, +5.3], McNemar p = 1.0 with 33 discordant pairs EACH WAY -- as close to identical quality as this instrument can show. The head spent 2.32x LESS compute, 5.53 actions against 19.81.
THE_RESULT.and the base never reaches the head's be: the head's best measured point is 35.0%% at 8,054 tokens. The base's best across 4,424-13,858 tokens is 24.0%%. At 1.7x the head's spend the base does not reach what the head reaches at 8k.
THE_RESULT.the plateau extends to the top: base@18 -> base@24 (+34%% compute) is +2.0 points, CI [-1.7, +5.7], p = 0.377 -- not established. The base is flat from 9.2k to 13.9k tokens.

WHICH_PRE_WRITTEN_READING_APPLIES.above across the range: YES. Every head point is above the base curve at comparable compute; the four nearest-compute pairings are +5.3 / +8.3 / +14.7 / +9.3, all CIs excluding zero.
WHICH_PRE_WRITTEN_READING_APPLIES.cross at low budget: NOT OBSERVED in the measured range. head@6, the cheapest head point, still beats base@12 by +5.3 [+0.3, +10.3]. The curves may still cross BELOW 5,979 tokens -- outside what was measured, and 8a must not claim otherwise.
WHICH_PRE_WRITTEN_READING_APPLIES.merge at high budget: NOT OBSERVED. The base at its top (13,858 tokens) equals the head's CHEAPEST point, not its best. Compute does not substitute for the prior anywhere in this range.

base@18_vs_base@24.method: paired per-problem bootstrap, 10000 resamples; exact two-sided binomial on the discordant pairs
